mechanism: Carisoprodol is metabolized by CYP2C19 and methylprednisolone can inhibit this enzyme, potentially increasing carisoprodol levels and CNS depression risk; additionally, both agents carry independent GI bleeding risk when used concomitantly.
action: Monitor for increased carisoprodol side effects (dizziness, sedation) and GI symptoms; consider dose reduction of carisoprodol if signs of toxicity emerge; use gastroprotection if indicated.
